name: Heavy Brass Button
descriptions: A solid button made of tarnished brass.
Engraved with a simple, repeating pattern.
Likely fell off old workwear or military uniform.

name: Chunk of Smoky Quartz
descriptions: A decent-sized crystal fragment of smoky quartz.
Translucent with internal fractures.
A nice, natural find.

name: Small Locket (Empty)
descriptions: A tarnished metal locket on a short, broken chain.
Snaps open but contains no pictures or contents.
Suggests a personal item that was lost.

name: Painted Ceramic Shard
descriptions: A fragment of old pottery with faded colored glaze.
Shows a portion of a floral or geometric design.
Hints at past settlement or activity.

name: Worn Leather Pouch
descriptions: A small, drawstring pouch made of aged leather.
Feels soft and flexible from use.
Currently empty, but might have held small items.

name: Flattened Lead Musketball
descriptions: A deformed lead ball, likely from a muzzle-loading firearm.
Shows signs of impact.
A relic of older conflicts or hunting.

name: Cobalt Blue Glass Shard
descriptions: A smooth shard of vibrantly colored blue glass.
Possibly from an old bottle or decorative item.
Its rich color makes it stand out.

name: Rusty Pocket Knife
descriptions: A small folding knife, heavily rusted shut.
The handle is cracked or worn.
Likely lost and exposed to the elements.

name: Oddly Shaped River Stone
descriptions: A stone smoothed by water, but with an unusual, almost artificial shape.
Fits comfortably in the hand.
A unique natural curiosity.

name: Bent Copper Wire
descriptions: A length of thick copper wire, twisted and bent.
Shows signs of being part of a mechanism or structure.
Salvaged or lost from old construction.

name: Broken Spectacles Frame
descriptions: Part of an old eyeglass frame, made of thin metal or bone.
One of the arms is snapped off.
Lost or discarded vision aid.

name: Petrified Wood Shard
descriptions: A piece of ancient wood that has turned to stone.
Retains the texture of bark or grain.
A geological remnant of an old forest.

name: Small Tin Soldier
descriptions: A miniature figurine of a soldier, made of lead or tin.
Missing a limb or accessory.
A child's lost toy from a different era.

name: Fragment of a Hand Mirror
descriptions: A piece of polished glass backed with silvering.
Too small to reflect much, but shows skilled craftsmanship.
From a personal grooming item.

name: Unusual Seed Pod
descriptions: A large, durable seed pod from a plant not native to the area.
Intact and feels surprisingly light.
Carried here by wind, water, or animal.

name: Cracked Porcelain Doll Head
descriptions: The head of a small doll, made of painted porcelain.
Features a prominent crack.
A slightly eerie find.

name: Old Horseshoe
descriptions: A rusty horseshoe, slightly bent.
Shows signs of wear from use.
Dropped by a horse, likely long ago.

name: Piece of Driftwood (Carved)
descriptions: A smoothed piece of wood carried by water.
Has simple, intentional carvings on its surface.
Perhaps a trail marker or bored traveler's work.

name: Smooth Beach Stone (Unusual Color)
descriptions: A perfectly smooth stone, worn round by water.
Exhibits a vibrant or unusual color.
A pleasing natural artifact.

name: Thimble (Metal)
descriptions: A small metal cap used for sewing.
Dented from use.
Likely fell from a traveler's kit.

name: Fragment of Slate with Markings
descriptions: A piece of flat slate rock.
Has faint lines or symbols scratched into it.
Could be a child's drawing or a forgotten note.

name: Glass Marble (Old Style)
descriptions: A solid glass marble with a swirl pattern inside.
Slightly chipped or scuffed.
Lost from a game played long ago.

name: Small Bone Dice
descriptions: A tiny six-sided die carved from bone.
Numbers are marked with small dots.
Well-worn from much use.

name: Segment of Chain Link
descriptions: A few links of heavy metal chain.
Rusted and separated from a larger piece.
Possibly from old restraints or equipment.

name: Clay Smoking Pipe Bowl (Broken)
descriptions: The ceramic bowl of an old smoking pipe.
The stem is snapped off.
A common personal item from history.
